skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 2 combo strikes to a single target for 90% ATK(+5) DMG each.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 2 combo strikes to all enemies, dealing DMG equal to 24% of Genos' max HP(+1), with a 100% chance to inflict [Burn] on the main target and those around it for 2 turns (DoT equal to 70% ATK).After casting, Genos loses 70% max HP until the end of the current turn.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 2 combo strikes to all enemies, dealing DMG equal to 32% of Genos' max HP(+1), with a 100% chance to inflict [Burn] on the main target and those around it for 2 turns (DoT equal to 90% ATK).After casting, Genos loses 90% max HP until the end of the current turn.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20).After taking fatal DMG, triggers [Regeneration] (while an ally is present, recovers 50% HP before Genos' next action to keep fighting, up to 1 time). When [Regeneration] triggers, deals bonus DMG equal to 160% ATK to all enemies.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20).After taking fatal DMG, triggers [Regeneration] (while an ally is present, recovers 75% HP before Genos' next action to keep fighting, up to 1 time). When [Regeneration] triggers, deals bonus DMG equal to 180% ATK to all enemies.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20).After taking fatal DMG, triggers [Regeneration] (while an ally is present, recovers 75% HP before Genos' next action to keep fighting, up to 2 times). When [Regeneration] triggers, deals bonus DMG equal to 200% ATK to all enemies.

effects.desc: Continuous fire damage over time to the target.
Restores Health over time or before the unit's next action.
